crimson-warden.text: RFV Crimson Warden — Rex Fleet carrier of Ember lineage. Institutional Fleet grammar remains deep blue, Ion White and restrained gold; the ship carries disciplined ember-crimson markings and darker industrial deck spaces. Its culture values staying operational under pressure and accepts command as responsibility for costs, not entitlement.

verge-relief-convoy.text: Verge relief convoy — civilian and contract freighters moving food, medical stores, replacement habitat hardware and passengers through an inter-faction corridor. Hulls are mismatched, practical and repaired repeatedly; crews are civilian, not a Fleet auxiliary.

unmarked-raider-pack.text: Unmarked raider splinter group — small opportunistic strike craft with mixed salvaged hulls and no recognized Crown or Shard faction insignia. They are not representative of the Shards as a whole; their objective is to strip a damaged convoy before Fleet cover can stabilize it.
